description: On the table there’s a yellow cup near the back, a cluster of purple and red grapes and a yellow pepper in the middle, a small purple fruit and a bread roll to the right, and a small orange in front. The left hand stays mostly still on the left, while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the orange as a right-hand object, lifts it up and forward to the yellow cup, then drops it into the cup and pulls away with empty fingers.
